title: Type 2 Diabetes
mealGuidance: Prefer low-GI carbs (millets, oats, dal), fiber 25-30g, avoid added sugar; small frequent meals. WHO: limit free sugars <10% kcal. Mayo: choose whole grains, lean protein.
exerciseGuidance: 150 min/week moderate aerobic + 2x resistance. Walking post-meal lowers glucose. Avoid prolonged sitting.

title: Hypertension
mealGuidance: DASH: low sodium <2000 mg, potassium-rich (banana, curd), whole grains, low saturated fat.
exerciseGuidance: 30 min brisk walk 5x/wk, isometric handgrip 3x/wk (Mayo). Avoid Valsalva heavy lifts.

title: Low Muscle Mass
mealGuidance: Protein 2.0-2.4 g/kg when cutting, spread 4x/day, creatine-rich foods (if approved). Surplus 300 kcal for lean bulk.
exerciseGuidance: Progressive overload 3-4x/wk resistance, 6-12 reps, 10-20 sets/muscle/week. Prioritize sleep 8h.

title: Obesity
mealGuidance: Deficit 300-500 kcal, high satiety (protein + fiber), limit ultra-processed. WHO: track 7-day avg weight.

title: High Cholesterol
mealGuidance: Soluble fiber (oats, psyllium), nuts, olive oil; limit trans fat, <7% saturated. Plant stanols.
exerciseGuidance: Aerobic 30 min 5x/wk lowers LDL. Interval training effective.

title: Iron-deficiency Anemia
mealGuidance: Heme iron (if non-veg) + vitamin C pairing; millets, leafy greens. Avoid tea with meals.
exerciseGuidance: Light-moderate; defer heavy if Hb low. May need medical clearance.

title: PCOS
mealGuidance: Low GI, anti-inflammatory, inositol-rich, weight -5% helps. Limit refined carbs.

title: Hypothyroidism
mealGuidance: Adequate iodine/selenium, avoid excess goitrogen raw large amounts. Maintain deficit/bulk per goal.
exerciseGuidance: Regular moderate activity combats weight gain; strength 2x/wk.

title: Osteoporosis risk
mealGuidance: Calcium 1000-1200 mg + vitamin D, protein adequate.
exerciseGuidance: Weight-bearing + resistance; balance training. Avoid spinal flexion heavy.

title: NAFLD (Fatty liver)
mealGuidance: Mediterranean, limit fructose/alcohol, gradual deficit 0.5 kg/wk.
exerciseGuidance: 150 min moderate + resistance 2x/wk reduces liver fat.

title: Stress & Poor Sleep
mealGuidance: Limit caffeine <200mg past noon, magnesium foods, regular meal timing.
exerciseGuidance: Yoga/breathwork 10 min + morning light 10 min; avoid vigorous close to bed.

title: Pre-diabetes
mealGuidance: Same as diabetes T2 early — prevent progression.
